passages.text: In the second year of the reign of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz over Israel, Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah became king of Judah.
This happened in the second year of Jehoash’s reign over Israel.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְיוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ יוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah became king of Judah.
Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king.
Amaziah ruled in Jerusalem.
Amaziah reigned for twenty-nine years.
Amaziah’s mother was Jehoaddan.
Jehoaddan was from Jerusalem.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְהוֹעַדִּין מִן־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father David had done. He did everything as his father Joash had done.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Amaziah did not do as his ancestor David had done.
Amaziah did everything as his father Joash had done.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א כְּדָוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו כְּכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֛ה יוֹאָ֥שׁ אָבִ֖יו עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away, and the people continued sacrificing and burning incense on the high places.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king in Jerusalem.
He did not remove the high places.
The people kept sacrificing on the high places.
The people kept burning incense on the high places.
passages.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah became king of Judah.
He gained full control over the kingdom.
Amaziah’s rule became strong and secure.
Some servants had killed his father, the former king.
Amaziah executed those servants who murdered his father.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו הַמַּכִּ֖ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: Yet he did not put the sons of the murderers to death, but acted according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah did not kill the sons of the men who murdered his father.
He obeyed what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses.
The LORD commanded this law.
The law says: Fathers must not be put to death for their children.
Children must not be put to death for their fathers.
Each person must die for his own sin.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמַּכִּ֖ים לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כַּכָּת֣וּב בְּסֵ֣פֶר תּֽוֹרַת־ מֹ֠שֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־ יוּמְת֨וּ אָב֤וֹת עַל־ בָּנִים֙ וּבָנִים֙ לֹא־ יוּמְת֣וּ עַל־ אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִם־ אִ֥ישׁ בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יָמוּת׃

passages.text: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He took Sela in battle and called it Joktheel, which is its name to this very day.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah fought against Edom.
He struck down 10,000 Edomites.
This happened in the Valley of Salt.
Amaziah captured the city called Sela in battle.
He gave the city a new name.
He called it Joktheel.
The city is still called Joktheel today.
passages.original: הוּא־ הִכָּ֨ה אֶת־ אֱד֤וֹם בְּגֵיא־ הַמֶּלַח עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְתָפַ֥שׂ אֶת־ הַסֶּ֖לַע בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־ שְׁמָהּ֙ יָקְתְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu. “Come, let us meet face to face,” he said.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoahaz was the son of Jehu.
Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash.
Amaziah gave them a message for Jehoash.
Amaziah said, “Come, let us meet face to face.”
passages.original: אָ֣ז שָׁלַ֤ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן־ יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לְכָ֖ה נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים׃

passages.text: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehoash sent a message to Amaziah.
Jehoash said, “A thistle grew in Lebanon.
The thistle sent a message to a cedar tree in Lebanon.
The thistle said, ‘Give your daughter to my son as a wife.’
A wild animal lived in Lebanon.
The wild animal passed by.
The wild animal trampled the thistle.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל־ הָאֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּלְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽה־ אֶת־ בִּתְּךָ֥ לִבְנִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן וַתִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־ הַחֽוֹחַ׃

passages.text: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has become proud. Glory in that and stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?”
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehoash spoke to Amaziah.
He said, “You defeated Edom.
This victory made your heart proud.
Be content with your success.
Stay at home.
Do not seek more conflict.
If you start trouble, you will fall.
You will fall, and Judah will fall with you.”
passages.original: הַכֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֱד֔וֹם וּֽנְשָׂאֲךָ֖ לִבֶּ֑ךָ הִכָּבֵד֙ וְשֵׁ֣ב בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וְלָ֤מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּרָעָ֔ה וְנָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: But Amaziah would not listen, and Jehoash king of Israel advanced. He and King Amaziah of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah did not listen to Jehoash’s warning.
Jehoash, king of Israel, marched forward.
Jehoash and Amaziah met face to face.
They met at Beth-shemesh.
Beth-shemesh belonged to Judah.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וַיַּ֨עַל יְהוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַאֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּבֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Judah was routed before Israel, and every man fled to his home.
passages.sermon:
Judah fought against Israel.
Israel defeated Judah.
The men of Judah ran away.
Each man from Judah fled to his own home.
passages.original: וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְאָהֳלוֹ׃

passages.text: There at Beth-shemesh, Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Joash was the son of Ahaziah.
Jehoash captured Amaziah at Beth-shemesh.
Jehoash went to Jerusalem.
Jehoash broke down part of the wall of Jerusalem.
He broke the wall from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
He broke a section of four hundred cubits.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ תָּפַ֛שׂ יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּפְרֹץ֩ בְּחוֹמַ֨ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם בְּשַׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ שַׁ֣עַר הַפִּנָּ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace, as well as some hostages. Then he returned to Samaria.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
He took all the gold.
He took all the silver.
He took all the articles found in the house of the LORD.
He took all the articles found in the treasuries of the royal palace.
He took some hostages.
He returned to Samaria.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־ כָּל־ הַזָּהָב־ וְ֠הַכֶּסֶף וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֜ים הַנִּמְצְאִ֣ים בֵּית־ יְהוָ֗ה וּבְאֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַתַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַיָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָה׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoash, along with his accomplishments, his might, and how he waged war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was king of Israel.
He did many things.
He showed great strength.
He fought against Amaziah, king of Judah.
The rest of Jehoash’s deeds are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Jehoash rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And his son Jeroboam reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Jehoash died.
People buried Jehoash in Samaria.
They buried him with the kings of Israel.
Jeroboam was Jehoash’s son.
Jeroboam became king after Jehoash.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יָרָבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Joash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Joash was king of Israel.
Joash king of Israel died.
Amaziah king of Judah lived for fifteen years after Joash died.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַֽחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ יְהֽוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Other acts of Amaziah exist.
Writers recorded these acts.
They wrote them in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And conspirators plotted against Amaziah in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Some people in Jerusalem plotted against Amaziah.
Amaziah heard about the plot.
Amaziah fled from Jerusalem.
Amaziah went to Lachish.
Men were sent after Amaziah to Lachish.
These men found Amaziah in Lachish.
They killed Amaziah there.
passages.original: וַיִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥יו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַֽחֲרָיו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁה וַיְמִתֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: They carried him back on horses and buried him in Jerusalem with his fathers in the City of David.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Men killed Amaziah in Lachish.
They carried Amaziah’s body on horses.
They brought him to Jerusalem.
They buried Amaziah with his fathers.
They buried him in the City of David.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ הַסּוּסִ֑ים וַיִּקָּבֵ֧ר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃

passages.text: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was sixteen years old.
All the people of Judah took Azariah.
They made Azariah king.
Azariah became king instead of his father Amaziah.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ כָּל־ עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וְה֕וּא בֶּן־ שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֣כוּ אֹת֔וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥יו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Azariah was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after King Amaziah rested with his fathers.
passages.sermon: Azariah became king after his father Amaziah died.\r\nAzariah rebuilt the city of Elath.\r\nAzariah gave Elath back to Judah.
passages.original: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ אֵילַ֔ת וַיְשִׁבֶ֖הָ לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Amaziah son of Joash over Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria forty-one years.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was the son of Jehoash.
Jeroboam became king of Israel.
He began to reign in the fifteenth year of Amaziah’s rule.
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Jeroboam ruled in Samaria.
He reigned for forty-one years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ חֲמֵשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַאֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יָרָבְעָ֨ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְאַחַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
He did evil in the sight of the LORD.
He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
Jeroboam son of Nebat caused Israel to sin.
Jeroboam son of Jehoash continued in these sins.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִכָּל־ חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: This Jeroboam restored the boundary of Israel from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, according to the word that the LORD, the God of Israel, had spoken through His servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
He restored the boundary of Israel.
He restored it from Lebo-hamath to the Sea of the Arabah.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD spoke this word through His servant Jonah.
Jonah was the son of Amittai.
Jonah was a prophet from Gath-hepher.
Jeroboam restored the boundary as the LORD had said.
passages.original: ה֗וּא הֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־ יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה כִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּיַד־ עַבְדּ֞וֹ יוֹנָ֤ה בֶן־ אֲמִתַּי֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִגַּ֥ת הַחֵֽפֶר׃

passages.text: For the LORD saw that the affliction of the Israelites, both slave and free, was very bitter. There was no one to help Israel, and since the LORD had said that He would not blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, He saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD saw the suffering of the Israelites.
Their suffering was very bitter.
Both slaves and free people in Israel suffered.
No one helped Israel.
The LORD did not say He would destroy the name of Israel from under heaven.
The LORD saved Israel.
He saved them through Jeroboam, son of Jehoash.
passages.original: כִּי־ רָאָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ עֳנִ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֹרֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאֶ֤פֶס עָצוּר֙ וְאֶ֣פֶס עָז֔וּב וְאֵ֥ין עֹזֵ֖ר לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וְלֹא־ דִבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לִמְחוֹת֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיעֵ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, along with all his accomplishments and might, and how he waged war and recovered both Damascus and Hamath for Israel from Judah, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
He did many things.
He showed great strength.
He fought in wars.
He took back Damascus for Israel.
He took back Hamath for Israel.
He took these cities from Judah.
All the other acts of Jeroboam are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יָרָבְעָ֜ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּגְבוּרָת֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ נִלְחָ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֜יב אֶת־ דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק וְאֶת־ חֲמָ֛ת לִיהוּדָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. And his son Zechariah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
Jeroboam died.
Jeroboam was buried with his ancestors.
His ancestors were kings of Israel.
Zechariah was Jeroboam’s son.
Zechariah became king after Jeroboam.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יָֽרָבְעָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ זְכַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
